verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.chronicle-labs.com with a structured, agent-readable index, and a second llms.txt on the marketing site describes product capabilities. Doc pages are also served as raw .md URLs (e.g., introduction.md, platform/twins.md, api-reference/authentication.md), which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or bundled full-docs export, and no first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs.
